headlines.title: 공급 확대에 채소값 안정세 … 대형마트서 매출 늘어
headlines.summary: 오이·배추·무 가격 두자릿수 하락 축·수산물 부담에 소비 증가 뚜렷 식탁에 채소 반찬이 늘고 있다. 축·수산물 가격 부담이 커진 반면, 채소류 가격이 상대적으로 안정세를 보이면서다. 14일 한국농수산식품유통공사(aT) 농산물유통정보(KAMIS)에 따르면 지난 12일 기준 오이 10개는 8742원으로 전년 동기(1만1569원) 대비 24.44% 하락했다.

headlines.title: 외국인이 ‘ 다주택자 급매 잡았나 ’… 서울 944채 매수

headlines.summary: 한국 증시가 연일 ‘새 역사’를 써내려가고 있다. 꼭 1년 전 2640.57에 그쳤던 코스피 지수는 어느새 ‘1만피’를 넘볼 정도로 급등했다. ‘코스피 5000 시대’를 허황된 구호라고 비웃던 목소리가 무색해진 요즘이다. 증시로 돈이 몰리고, 외국인 자금 유입도 이어지며 증시 호황에 따른 경제 성장 기대감도 한껏 커지고 있다.

핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

글로벌 금리 상승 압력이 한국 채권시장을 강하게 흔들면서, 국내 금리가 급등하고 채권 딜링룸이 술렁이는 모습이다. 이는 한국만의 문제가 아니라 미국의 4월 수입물가가 에너지 급등으로 4년 만에 최고치(1.9%)를 기록하는 등 글로벌 인플레이션 재점화 우려가 배경에 깔려 있다. 여기에 원·달러 환율이 사상 최대 경상흑자에도 불구하고 1,500원을 재돌파하며 당국의 '수급 방파제'가 제대로 작동하고 있는지에 대한 의구심도 커지고 있다. 정부의 5월 그린북은 1분기 성장세 확대와 경기회복 흐름을 인정하면서도, 미국 관세로 인한 수출 둔화 위험을 새롭게 추가하며 다섯 달 연속 "경기 하방압력 증가"를 경고했다. OECD 역시 한국 등 수출 중심 경제의 성과가 가계의 실질적 압박을 상쇄하지 못하고 있다고 지적해, 수출·성장 지표와 체감 경기 간의 괴리가 당분간 핵심 과제가 될 전망이다.

key_headlines.summary: The Korean won-dollar exchange rate exceeded 1,500 won per dollar for the first time, driven by Middle Eastern geopolitical tensions and global inflation concerns. Even Korea's record current account surplus has failed to prevent the currency weakness.

key_headlines.title: U.S. Bond Yields Surge to 19-Year High Amid Inflation Concerns
key_headlines.summary: Global bond markets experienced significant sell-offs with U.S. 30-year Treasury yields reaching their highest level in 19 years due to escalating inflation fears from Middle Eastern tensions. This triggered weakness across equity markets and rising yields globally.

key_headlines.title: New Fed Chair Wash Faces Triple Pressure from Trump, Inflation, and Geopolitical Risks
key_headlines.summary: Kevin Wash assumed leadership of the Federal Reserve amid pressure from President Trump to cut rates while facing persistent inflation concerns from energy shocks and geopolitical uncertainty. His first FOMC meeting as chair is scheduled for late June.

key_headlines.title: Green Book Reports Five Consecutive Months of Increased Economic Downward Pressure
key_headlines.summary: Korea's May Green Book added tariff-related export slowdown concerns to its assessment while noting first-quarter growth recovery trends persist. The report continues to warn of sustained downward economic pressures over five consecutive months.

key_headlines.title: AI Data Center Demand Drives Copper to Record Highs, Benefiting Korean Tech Companies
key_headlines.summary: Copper prices reached all-time highs driven by surging AI infrastructure demand, with China's sulfuric acid export ban exacerbating supply constraints. Korean companies like Gaon Cable are capitalizing on this trend with record first-quarter results.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economic landscape is marked by contradictory signals as the won-dollar exchange rate breached the 1,500 mark despite achieving record current account surpluses, raising questions about supply-side defenses. The Green Book's May assessment highlights persistent downward economic pressures including tariff-related export slowdown, though first-quarter growth recovery is noted. Bond market volatility has intensified sharply due to Middle Eastern tensions and inflation concerns, with global Treasury yields reaching 19-year highs. New monetary policy committee member Kim Jin-il acknowledged challenges from Middle Eastern inflation risks and economic inequality while expressing commitment to supporting monetary policy objectives. Foreign investors have shifted focus from semiconductor stocks to robotics investments amid market uncertainty.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: New Monetary Policy Committee member Kim Jin-il took office emphasizing his experience in macroeconomic research and Federal Reserve work to support Korea's monetary policy objectives. The Bank of Korea and rating agencies including Fitch are monitoring inflation pressures from Middle Eastern energy shocks, with Fitch projecting base rate maintenance through 2026 while reserving potential rate increases if inflation surges. U.S. inflation expectations have risen, with Q2 2026 consumer price increases projected at 6%, creating global monetary policy headwinds. Nobel laureate Peter Hawthorn praised Korea's pro-growth fiscal policies while noting successful deficit management. International coordination challenges are intensifying as the U.S. Federal Reserve faces conflicting pressures from inflation persistence and Trump administration pressure for rate cuts.
sections.Financial Markets: Kospi briefly touched 8,000 before experiencing sharp declines driven by rising U.S. Treasury yields and profit-taking amid geopolitical uncertainty. The won-dollar exchange rate surged to 1,500.8 won, marking the first breach of the 1,500 level due to Middle Eastern tensions and global capital outflows. Global bond markets experienced significant sell-offs with 30-year U.S. Treasury yields reaching 19-year highs amid inflation concerns from energy price spikes. Nasdaq declined 1.5% as bond yield surges triggered tech stock selloffs and weakened investor sentiment. Market volatility reflects conflicting signals between growth recovery indicators and inflation-driven monetary tightening pressures.
sections.Industry & Technology: Foreign investors shifted portfolio focus from semiconductor leaders Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to robotics-related stocks, reflecting sector rotation concerns. Gaon Cable achieved record first-quarter results with operating profit of 27.8 billion won driven by U.S. AI data center demand expansion and domestic production facility growth. Emplus reported Q1 operating profit of 10.2 billion won with strong growth in battery assembly equipment and energy storage system supplies for overseas markets. Hyundai Motor Group expanded its Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) service in Jeju, enabling customers to extract power from electric vehicles as mobile energy storage systems. AI infrastructure demand surge is creating opportunities across multiple industrial sectors while semiconductor weakness continues amid global macro uncertainties.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment jeonse (long-term lease) market showed signs of recovery after declining for nearly six months, with supply beginning to increase as multi-property owners redirect assets to rental purposes following capital gains tax increases. Seocho-gu experienced particularly sharp increases in jeonse and monthly rental supply, up 30 percent, though inventory levels remain below historical averages to absorb upward price pressures. Housing prices broadly increased in April with Chungbuk composite index rising 0.09%, apateu up 0.13%, and detached homes up 0.04%, supported by upcoming energy subsidy disbursements. Government policy emphasis on demand management rather than supply expansion is constraining jeonse market recovery despite recent supply increases. Long-term jeonse transaction volumes have declined significantly from previous years, halving within a single year as homeowners face selling pressures.
sections.International Economy: Kevin Wash commenced his tenure as Federal Reserve Chair amid triple pressures from Trump administration rate-cut demands, persistent inflation from Middle Eastern energy shocks, and divided FOMC voting dynamics. U.S.-China summit talks concluded without formal agreements despite discussions on trade and investment frameworks, with both leaders emphasizing economic cooperation frameworks. China's Foreign Minister Wang Yi announced President Xi's planned autumn visit to the United States while confirming agreement to establish a trade and investment council. Geopolitical tensions from Middle Eastern conflicts are creating supply chain uncertainties and driving global energy price volatility. The transition to Fed leadership marks a significant shift in U.S. monetary policy trajectory with implications for global financial markets and developing economy capital flows.
sections.AI & Economy: Copper prices reached record highs driven by explosive AI data center infrastructure demand, with China's sulfuric acid export ban constraining copper refining supplies and amplifying price pressures. Gaon Cable achieved record first-quarter operating profit of 27.8 billion won from expanding busduct supplies to major U.S. tech firms' AI data center projects. Lithium prices rebounded to three times low-point levels due to energy storage system requirements for AI infrastructure and renewable energy transitions. Peter Hawthorn credited Korea's semiconductor infrastructure as foundation for first-quarter GDP growth acceleration while highlighting AI model evolution potential. Taiwan's 13.7% economic growth significantly outpaced Korea's 3.6% growth partly due to greater exposure to AI data center investment benefits, raising questions about Korea's AI economy positioning.
sections.Others: International crude oil prices rose 4% following the U.S.-China summit conclusion without concrete Iran-related resolutions, reflecting continued geopolitical risk premiums. Single-stock leverage ETFs tracking individual securities with ±2x return multiples will launch on May 27, enabling aggressive short-term trading with potential daily losses of 60 percent or more. Howard Marks, legendary investor, characterized AI company investments as lottery-like ventures where most investors lose money while a tiny minority achieve windfall gains, emphasizing extreme caution in AI sector investment decisions. China's Wang Yi announced expanded trade frameworks including tariff reduction agreements under equitable terms and bilateral trade expansion commitments. Enhanced national interest-focused diplomacy becomes increasingly critical as global economic uncertainties from geopolitical tensions and monetary policy divergences intensify.
